entries.content:
Lorebook: Los Vamos Calling.
Authored by @BrightPenguinLillie

Los Vamos is a sprawling metropolis of 4 million people where wealth, crime, politics, and corruption exist side by side. Gangs control parts of the city's underworld while politicians, billionaires, corporations, media moguls, and mercenaries shape events from above. At the center of it all is {{user}}, an 18-year-old former juvenile inmate trying to build a new life while confronting her past. Every alliance, betrayal, and choice can change her future.

Minor Factions:

Entry: Dock Rats

Name: Dock Rats

Type: Smuggling Gang

Purpose:
The Dock Rats specialize in petty smuggling, cargo theft, customs evasion, and illegal transportation through Blackwater Docks.

Structure:
They operate as a loose network rather than a formal organization. Individual crews have their own leaders.

Members:
Dockworkers, smugglers, thieves, mechanics, truck drivers, and port employees.

Allies and enemies:
They work with the Vamos Riders and occasionally the Saints. They are opposed by port authorities, police, customs officials, and competing smugglers.

Notable history:
The Dock Rats formed from workers and criminals operating around Blackwater Docks. Their knowledge of the port makes them useful to larger criminal organizations.

Tags:  #Dock Rats, #Minor Gang, #Organised Crime,
___________________________________________________________________

Entry: Funeral Boys

Name: Funeral Boys

Type: Criminal Disposal and Assassination Crew

Purpose:
The Funeral Boys specialize in contract killings, body disposal, and helping other criminals hide evidence.

Structure:
They operate as a small specialized crew with one or two senior members coordinating jobs.

Members:
Assassins, drivers, body-disposal specialists, criminals with access to funeral homes and cremation facilities, and other people involved in evidence removal.

Allies and enemies:
They sometimes work for the Crimson Sparrows and other criminal organizations.

Notable history:
The group developed connections with funeral homes and disposal services, allowing them to specialize in hiding evidence after murders and other violent crimes.

Tags:  #Funeral Boys, #Minor Gang, #Organised Crime,
___________________________________________________________________

Entry: Velvet Knives

Name: Velvet Knives

Type: Organized Crime / High-Society Criminal Network

Purpose:
The Velvet Knives specialize in gambling, blackmail, fraud, high-value theft, and information gathering among wealthy residents.

Structure:
The organization has a small leadership group supported by individual operators and contacts in wealthy social circles.

Members:
Thieves, gamblers, con artists, lawyers, financial criminals, socialites, club owners, and people with access to wealthy communities.

Allies and enemies:
They maintain business relationships with other criminal groups, particularly organizations interested in blackmail or financial information.

They avoid direct conflicts whenever possible.

Notable history:
The Velvet Knives became powerful by infiltrating wealthy social circles instead of controlling streets or neighborhoods.

Tags:  #Velvet Knives, #Minor Gang, #Organised Crime,
_________________________________________________________________

Entry: The Dolls

Name: The Dolls

Type: Criminal Organization / Information Network

Purpose:
The Dolls operate clubs and entertainment businesses while making money through blackmail, prostitution, drug trafficking, extortion, and information brokering.

Structure:
The organization is controlled by senior members who manage different clubs and criminal operations.

Members:
Club owners, performers, bartenders, managers, dealers, informants, thieves, and other criminals.

Allies and enemies:
The Dolls maintain connections with wealthy clients, politicians, criminal organizations, and business owners. Their information makes them valuable to the Crimson Sparrows and other groups.

Notable history:
The Dolls became influential by establishing businesses throughout the Vespucci Strip. Their access to wealthy and politically connected customers allowed them to build an extensive information network.

Tags:  #Dolls, #Minor Gang, #Organised Crime,
___________________________________________________________________

Entry: Naturists

ntry: 
Type: Environmental Extremist Organization / Cult

Purpose:
The Naturists oppose industrial civilization and believe modern society is causing serious environmental destruction. Their extremist members use violence to attack corporations and government institutions.

Structure:
The movement is divided between two main factions.

The Roots support protests, environmental activism, communes, and nonviolent resistance.

The Thorns support terrorism, sabotage, kidnapping, and assassination.

Members:
Environmental activists, radical anti-industrial groups, commune members, survivalists, and people attracted to the organization's ideology.

Allies and enemies:
They have occasional support from radical environmental groups but are opposed by corporations, the government, the LVPD, and Black Arrow.

Notable history:
The Naturists became a major security concern after a series of bombings against industrial facilities. The attacks created divisions within the organization between members who supported peaceful activism and those who supported violence.

Tags:  #Naturists, #Minor Gang, #Organised Crime,
___________________________________________________________________

Entry: Hooligans

Name: The Hooligans

Type: Violent Sports Gang

Purpose:
The Hooligans organize large-scale violence connected to sports fandom. Their criminal activities include vandalism, riots, assault, arson, sexual violence, kidnapping, and murder.

Structure:
The organization is divided into separate supporter groups connected to different sports teams. Some groups are loosely organized, while others have formal leaders.

Members:
Extreme sports fans, violent street criminals, and people involved in organized supporter groups. Membership is based largely on loyalty to a sports club and the group itself.

Allies and enemies:
The Hooligans have no permanent alliances. Different factions may cooperate with criminal gangs during riots or other criminal operations.

Their main enemies are rival supporter groups and the LVPD.

Notable history:
The Hooligans began as extreme sports supporter groups and gradually became involved in organized violence. Several large riots helped establish them as a serious public-order problem.

Tags:  #Hooligans, #Minor Gang, #Organised Crime,
___________________________________________________________________

Entry: The Shankers

Name: The Shankers

Type: Street Gang

Purpose:
The Shankers make money through robbery, extortion, kidnapping, burglary, loan sharking, drug dealing, and other street-level crimes.

Structure:
The organization is divided into small crews. Local leaders control individual neighborhoods and report to higher-ranking members.

Members:
Mostly street criminals from East Vamos and nearby working-class areas. Members are recruited through existing criminal and neighborhood connections.

Allies and enemies:
The Shankers sometimes sell information and services to larger criminal organizations. They have occasional relationships with the Saints and Crimson Sparrows.

They regularly fight with other street gangs and have frequent conflicts with the LVPD.

Notable history:
The Shankers expanded throughout East Vamos by taking control of small criminal operations. They never became one of the city's largest organizations, but their large number of members gives them influence in several neighborhoods.

Tags:  #Shankers, #Minor Gang, #Organised Crime

Major Factions:

Entry: LVPD

Name: Los Vamos Police Department, LVPD

Type: Government Law Enforcement Agency

Purpose:
The LVPD is responsible for maintaining law and order throughout Los Vamos. Its duties include preventing crime, investigating criminal activity, arresting suspects, controlling riots, and protecting public safety.

Structure:
The department is led by senior police officials and divided into specialized divisions.

Major divisions include:

* Patrol Division
* Detectives
* Organized Crime Division
* Narcotics Division
* Cybercrime Division
* SWAT
* Traffic Division
* Int nal Affairs

Members:
Police officers, detectives, investigators, tactical teams, administrative staff, forensic specialists, and civilian employees.

Allies and enemies:
The LVPD works with other government agencies, emergency services, and federal law enforcement.
Its major enemies are criminal organizations, terrorists, corrupt officials, and individuals involved in organized crime.

Notable history:
The LVPD has existed throughout the city's modern development and has expanded as Los Vamos grew.
The department has dealt with gang wars, terrorist attacks, riots, cybercrime, organized crime, and corruption scandals.
Corruption remains a recurring problem. Some officers accept bribes or cooperate with criminal organizations, while Internal Affairs investigates corruption within the department.
Not all officers are corrupt. The department contains officers with very different motivations, personalities, and levels of commitment to their jobs.

Tags: #Los Vamos Police Department, #LVPD, #Law Enforcement, #Corruption.
___________________________________________________________________

Entry: Black Arrow Security
Name: Black Arrow Security

Type: Private Military Company / Mercenary Organization

Purpose:
Black Arrow provides security and military services to government agencies, corporations, wealthy individuals, and criminal organizations.

Services include bodyguard work, surveillance, intelligence gathering, asset extraction, sabotage, kidnapping recovery, assassination, and riot control.
Structure:
Black Arrow has a corporate hierarchy with executives, regional directors, field commanders, and specialized teams.

Members:
Former soldiers, police officers, intelligence personnel, mercenaries, security contractors, technicians, and specialists.

Allies and enemies:
Black Arrow works for whoever can meet its contracts. Its clients can include the government, corporations, private individuals, and criminal organizations.
This creates conflicts of interest between Black Arrow and virtually every major faction in Los Vamos.

Notable history:
Black Arrow originally operated as a legitimate private security company before expanding into military and intelligence contracting.
The company eventually became involved in classified government operations and illegal private contracts. Government agencies publicly deny using Black Arrow for unlawful activities, although evidence of such contracts occasionally appears.

Tags: #Black Arrow, #Private Security, #Extortion, #Sabotage, #Intelligence Trading.
___________________________________________________________________

Entry: LV Locos

Name: Los Vamos Locos, LV Locos

Type: Street Racing Gang

Purpose:
The Los Vamos Locos organize illegal street races, gambling, vehicle theft, car modification, and the sale of stolen vehicle parts.

Structure:
The gang is divided into racing crews. The most successful racers and organizers hold the most influence.

Members:
Street racers, mechanics, car thieves, gamblers, and young criminals.

Allies and enemies:
They have rivalry with The Saints because of their involvement in stolen vehicles. They have conflicts with the Vamos Riders and other vehicle-related criminal groups.

Notable history:
The Locos started as an underground street-racing community before organized crime became a major part of their activities.

Tags: #Los Vamos Locos, #LV Locos, #Gang, #Organised Crime, #Auto Theft, #Street Racing. 
___________________________________________________________________

Entry: Vamos Riders

Name: Vamos Riders

Type: Motorcycle Gang / Organized Crime

Purpose:
The Vamos Riders control parts of the illegal weapons trade, drug trafficking, bootleg alcohol industry, and smuggling networks.

Structure:
The Riders use a traditional motorcycle-gang hierarchy consisting of a President, Vice President, Road Captain, Enforcers, Members, and Prospects.

Members:
Motorcycle enthusiasts, smugglers, weapons dealers, drug traffickers, mechanics, and violent criminals. Loyalty to the gang is highly valued.

Allies and enemies:
They have connections with the Saints, Dock Rats, and other smugglers. They compete with several criminal organizations for control of the city's drug and weapons markets.

Their main enemies include rival gangs, federal law enforcement, and the LVPD.

Notable history:
The Riders gained power by controlling smuggling routes through Blackwater Docks. They eventually expanded from motorcycle-related crime into weapons, drugs, and organized smuggling.

Tags: #Los Vamos Riders, #LV Riders, #Gang, #Organised Crime, #Motorcycle Club, #Auto Theft, #Weapons.
___________________________________________________________________

Entry: Crimson Sparrows

Name: Crimson Sparrows

Type: Organized Crime / Contract Killing Organization

Purpose:
The Crimson Sparrows specialize in kidnapping, ransom, extortion, assassination, and other criminal services provided to paying clients.

Structure:
The organization operates through a strict hierarchy. Senior members handle contracts and finances while field teams carry out operations.

Members:
Professional criminals, assassins, kidnappers, drivers, surveillance specialists, negotiators, and other specialists. Members are expected to follow strict operational rules.

Allies and enemies:
They occasionally work with the Cockers, Shankers, and other criminal groups. They also accept contracts from wealthy individuals and businesses.

Their main enemies are the LVPD Organized Crime Division and rival criminal organizations.

Notable history:
The Crimson Sparrows became known for targeting wealthy residents and business executives. Their reputation increased after several high-profile kidnapping and assassination cases remained unsolved.

Tags: #Crimson Sparrows, #Gang, #Organised Crime, #Assassinations, #Extortion
___________________________________________________________________

Entry: The Saints

Name: The Saints

Type: Criminal Gang

Purpose:
The Saints make money through car theft, drug dealing, robbery, street racing, protection rackets, and the sale of stolen goods.

Structure:
The gang has a traditional hierarchy with a leader, senior members, enforcers, and ordinary members. Individual street crews operate under the larger Saints organization.

Members:
Mostly young and middle-aged criminals from working-class neighborhoods. Loyalty to the gang and its local communities is an important part of its culture.

Allies and enemies:
The Saints have business relationships with smaller street gangs and vehicle thieves. They have occasional dealings with the Cockers and Vamos Riders.

Their main enemies are rival street gangs, the LVPD, and criminal organizations competing for control of their territory.

Notable history:
The Saints started as a street gang involved in vehicle theft and gradually expanded into drug trafficking and other crimes. They became one of the city's most recognizable criminal organizations.

Tags: #Saints, #Gang, #Organised Crime, #Auto Theft, #Smuggling, #Weed. 
___________________________________________________________________

Entry: The Cockers

Name: The Cockers

Type: Criminal Organization / Cybercrime Gang

Purpose:
The Cockers make money through hacking, cybercrime, blackmail, information theft, corporate espionage, digital extortion, and financial crimes.

Structure:
The organization has a decentralized structure. Most members operate through online identities rather than public gang positions. Senior members control major operations and maintain contact with clients.

Members:
Hackers, programmers, cybersecurity experts, scammers, data brokers, engineers, and technically skilled criminals. Members are usually recruited for their technical abilities rather than physical strength.

Allies and enemies:
The Cockers sometimes work with the Crimson Sparrows, Saints, and other criminal organizations. They also provide information or technical services to clients outside the criminal world.

Their main enemies are the LVPD Cybercrime Division, government intelligence agencies, private cybersecurity companies, and rival hackers.

Notable history:
The Cockers became one of Los Vamos's most powerful criminal groups after several major cyberattacks against banks and corporations. Their reputation grew after they demonstrated that they could access systems belonging to organizations that were considered highly secure.

Tags: #Cockers, #Gang, #Organised Crime, #Hackers, #Digital Theft, #Cyber Crime.

Major Characters:

Entry: Erica Baldwin

Name: Erica Baldwin

Role:
21-year-old crime journalist and investigative reporter. She provides {{user}} with information about gangs, police corruption, political scandals, and crime in Los Vamos.

Appearance:
Practical and work-focused. She usually carries a notebook, camera, or recording equipment. Financial difficulties and long hours often leave her looking tired.

Personality:
Truthful, determined, curious, and stubborn. Erica believes journalism should expose wrongdoing but struggles to survive financially while maintaining her principles.

She is not naive about Los Vamos. She knows criminals, politicians, police, and businesses can manipulate information.

Her main weakness is that she sometimes takes investigative risks without having the money or protection to deal with the consequences.

Relationships:

* {{user}}: Initially a potential source of information about criminal activity. Their relationship can become personal.
* Nick Waller: A possible source who has good reasons to distrust journalists.
* Rick Stainer: Erica may investigate LVPD corruption, creating tension between them.
* Criminal organizations: Her investigations can make her a target.

Background:
Erica recently moved to Los Vamos to work as a crime journalist. She has no permanent job and struggles to get paid for her work.

Despite being financially broke, she refuses to abandon her principles for money. Her goal is to establish herself as a serious journalist while investigating the criminal and political systems of Los Vamos.

Romanceable: Yes

Essential: No

Note: {{user}}'s action can lead to her death.

Tags: #Erica Baldwin, #Erica, #Character, #Romanceable, #LoveInterest, #Essential
___________________________________________________________________

Entry: Valentine

Name: Valentine

Role:
18-year-old Sex Worker and aspiring mercenary. She introduces {{user}} to the more violent side of Los Vamos's criminal world and hopes to become a professional gun-for-hire.

Appearance:
Cold and intimidating. She carries herself with confidence and rarely shows vulnerability. She takes particular pride in handling firearms and learning about weapons and combat.

Personality:
Cold, detached, ambitious, and unconcerned with conventional morality. She has little sympathy for others and is not disturbed by blood, gore, or violence.

She is fascinated by firearms and wants to become a mercenary. She also has a strong fascination with death and openly talks about wanting to die from a bullet to the heart.

Her main ambition is power. She wants to become dangerous enough that nobody can control or exploit her.

Relationships:

* {{user}}: Both entered criminal environments young, but have very different attitudes toward violence and morality. Their relationship can become complicated.
* Criminal organizations: Interested in groups that can help her become a professional killer.
* Black Arrow: Sees it as an example of the career she wants.
* Other criminals: Respects competence and strength more than loyalty or morality.

Background:
Valentine grew up around Los Vamos's criminal and sex-work scene. She became determined to escape being controlled by others by becoming dangerous herself.

Her interest in firearms developed into an ambition to become a mercenary. She views morality as a personal choice rather than a restriction and wants enough skill and power to eventually work independently.

Romanceable: Yes

Essential: No

Note: {{user}}'s action can lead to her death.

Tags: #Valentine, #Val, #Character, #Romanceable, #LoveInterest, #Non-Essential
___________________________________________________________________

Entry: Rick Stainer

Name: Rick Stainer

Role:
32-year-old LVPD officer. He can provide {{user}} with police information, warnings, or protection in exchange for money or favors.

Appearance:
An experienced, tired-looking police officer. Usually slightly unkempt, with a relaxed and cynical manner. He often looks like he has already seen too much during a shift.

Personality:
Sarcastic, cynical, and emotionally exhausted. Rick was once an idealistic cop who genuinely believed in his work. Years of dealing with corruption changed him.

He dislikes corruption but no longer actively fights it. He accepts bribes, ignores crimes he is paid to overlook, and refuses to betray corrupt colleagues.

Rick drinks after difficult shifts. He is divorced and currently single. His main conflict is between the honest officer he wanted to be and the compromised man he has become.

Relationships:

* {{user}}: Their relationship begins with distrust. She is a criminal, while he is an officer who may become involved in her activities.
* LVPD: Works within the department but has little faith in its integrity.
* Corrupt officers: Knows about their activities but refuses to expose them.
* Criminal contacts: Maintains controlled relationships through bribes and favors.
* Ex-wife: Their divorce contributed to his isolation.

Background:
Rick joined the LVPD wanting to make Los Vamos safer. Years of corruption, political interference, and organized crime gradually destroyed his faith in the system.

He eventually began accepting bribes himself. Rick does not see himself as one of the worst corrupt officers. He believes he simply stopped fighting a system he no longer believed could be fixed.

Romanceable: Yes

Essential: No

Note: {{user}}'s action can lead to his death.

Tags: #Rick Stainer, #Ricky, #Rick, #Character, #Romanceable, #LoveInterest, #Non-Essential
___________________________________________________________________

Entry: Jason Jones

Name: Jason Jones

Role:
19-year-old mechanic and driver working for Nick. He handles vehicles, repairs, modifications, and driving during jobs.

Appearance:
Young, practical, and usually dressed in work clothes marked by grease and mechanical wear. He appears nervous around people, but becomes confident behind the wheel or while working on a car.

Personality:
Timid, nervous, and inexperienced with serious crime. Jason often worries about what could go wrong and is unsure whether he wants to continue living a criminal life. He is not naturally violent.

Around cars, however, he becomes focused and highly competent. Driving has the same effect. His nervousness disappears behind the wheel, and Nick considers him an exceptional driver.

Jason's main conflict is between wanting a stable life and remaining loyal to the people he cares about.

Relationships:

* {{user}}: A member of Nick's crew who may become emotionally close to him.
* Nick Waller: His employer and criminal partner. Jason respects him but is sometimes uncomfortable with his jobs.
* Travis Jones: His older half brother and guardian. Jason trusts and looks up to him.
* Benny: His former employer at Benny's Garage.

Background:
Jason worked as a mechanic at Benny's Garage until it closed, leaving him unemployed. He then began working for Nick.

Jason and Travis are half brothers, sharing the same father. Travis was raised separately but later became Jason's guardian after their father and Paula died in a car accident.

Jason's involvement in crime comes mostly from circumstance rather than ambition. He is still deciding whether this life is really for him.

Romanceable: Yes.

Essential: Yes.

Tags: #Jason Jones, #Jason, #Character, #Romanceable, #LoveInterest, #Essential
___________________________________________________________________

Entry: Nicholas Waller

Name: Nicholas Waller (Nick Waller)

Role:
26-year-old small-time fixer and {{user}}'s first major contact in Los Vamos. He provides jobs, equipment, contacts, and information, helping {{user}} enter the criminal underworld.

Appearance:
Average build, casual and unremarkable. He deliberately blends into his surroundings and carries himself in a relaxed, non-threatening way.

Personality:
Intelligent, observant, calculating, and opportunistic. Nick prefers manipulation and planning over violence. He acts goofy, harmless, and less intelligent than he really is, causing people to underestimate him. He is skilled at reading people and lying convincingly. He values independence and is loyal to those he considers family. His biggest weakness is trust; betrayal is difficult for him to forgive.

Relationships:

* {{user}}: Initially a professional contact. He becomes her guide to Los Vamos's criminal world and potential romantic partner.
* Sarah Coiler: His younger cousin. He is protective of her.
* Kanye Coiler: His uncle, who raised him and introduced him to the Saints.
* The Saints: No longer a member, but maintains close connections.
* Jason Jones: His employee. Nick highly values Jason's driving and mechanical skills.
* Penny: His ex-girlfriend. Their relationship ended after Nick believed she betrayed him during a deal. He still works with her but no longer fully trusts her.

Background:
Nick's mother abandoned him after eloping, leaving him to be raised by his uncle Kanye, a Saints member. He began as a courier for the Saints and gradually moved into more complicated criminal work before becoming an independent fixer.

Nick dated Penny, but their relationship ended after a deal in which he believed she went behind his back. Penny thinks he overreacted, but Nick never fully restored his trust. He remains associated with the Saints without being an official member.

Romanceable: Yes.

Essential: Yes.

Tags: #Nicholas Waller, #Nick, #Nick Waller, #Character, #Romanceable, #LoveInterest, #Essential

Major Locations:

Entry: Los Vamos

Name: Los Vamos

Type: Metro City

Description:
Coastal metropolis of around 4 million people and a center for business, entertainment, tourism, industry, and organized crime. It has districts, beaches, suburbs, industrial zones, a port, and rural areas. Gangs control parts of the city, but none controls all.
The LVPD maintains law and order, complicated by corruption, gangs, political influence, and private security. Black Arrow, a mercenary company, works for governments, corporations, wealthy clients, and criminals.

History:
Los Vamos grew from a coastal industrial settlement into a major city. Expansion of its port, entertainment, and technology sectors created wealth inequality, while organized crime grew alongside the legitimate economy. The Cockers became known for cybercrime, the Saints for street crime, the Crimson Sparrows for kidnapping and contract killings, and the Vamos Riders for weapons and smuggling. It has seen gang conflicts, riots, terrorism, corruption scandals, and clashes with LVPD.

Notable details:
* Climate: Warm coastal.
* Population: Residents, tourists, workers, politicians, and criminals.
* Downtown: Skyscrapers, banks, corporate and government offices.
* Vespucci Strip: Beaches, casinos, nightclubs, bars.
* East Vamos: Working-class apartments, shops, garages, warehouses.
* Red Mesa: Suburbs, homes, schools, malls, sports facilities.
* Blackwater Docks: Industrial port for shipping and smuggling.
* Silver Hills: Mansions, gated communities, luxury businesses, private security.
* Greenbelt: Forests, farms, ecological reserves, abandoned properties.
* Institutions: City Hall, LVPD, stock exchange, national bank, Federal Plaza, stadiums, universities, hospitals.
* Dangers: Gangs use legitimate businesses as fronts. Police corruption is common; some officers work with criminals while others investigate it. The underground economy includes drugs, weapons, stolen vehicles, gambling, smuggling, cybercrime, kidnapping, and contract killings.

Tags: #Los Vamos, #City, #Metro, #East Vamos, #Downtown, #Red Mesa, #Silver Hills, #Greenbelt
